I've built **TaskFlow**, a modern and feature-packed to-do application.

### 🌐 Preview Your App
👉 **[Open Live To-Do App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/ad454f75-5590-44ca-9a5b-676d79599810/cd6e803257365647941db4be/)**

---

### ✨ Key Features
- **Task & Subtask Management**: Full checklist support with progress tracking, priority badges (Urgent, High, Medium, Low), and due dates.
- **Smart Views & Filters**: Filter by *All Tasks*, *Today*, *Upcoming*, *Completed*, custom categories, and priority levels.
- **Instant Search & Sort**: Real-time search across titles, notes, and subtasks, plus sorting by due date, priority, or creation date.
- **Micro-Interactions & Audio**: Completion confetti celebrations, synthetic chime audio (Web Audio API with mute toggle), and undo toasts.
- **Dark & Light Mode**: Seamless dark mode support with automatic system preference detection and manual toggle.
- **Data Persistence & Backups**: LocalStorage auto-save, JSON backup export, and JSON import.
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Press <kbd>/</kbd> to search, <kbd>N</kbd> to create a task, and <kbd>Esc</kbd> to close dialogs.
